title: Granum Void/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Dialogue spoken while in the Granum Void.

path: Using Crown on Golden Hand Tribute
lines: - Lotus: "A Granum Void gateway has been opened. It won't last long. Move."
- Lotus: "Void disturbance. Tenno forces need backup within Granum's Void. Gateway collapse imminent."
- Lotus: "An expedition to Granum's Void has been initiated. Seconds away until gateway collapse, hurry."
- Lotus: "A gateway to Granum's Void has opened. Hurry, before it closes."
- Lotus: "Void rift detected, Granum's realm. It is already closing. If you want in, get moving."
- Lotus: "Ready your Xoris if it's equipped. Specter particle spillover imminent. Thin the specters and save any Solaris you can."
- Lotus: "Free stranded Solaris with the Xoris and destroy Parvos' specters. You don't have long."
**On freeing them**
- Female Solaris Prisoner 1: "...got me mixed up with someone...! Wait a minute."

- Lotus: "Specter particle count is below critical. Good work."
- Lotus: "Crisis averted. Prepare to disentangle from the Granum Void."

- Lotus: "That's enough, particle count dropping sharply on our side. Pulling you back."
- Lotus: "Particle reads have falling off a cliff. Good work. Prepare to disentangle."
